new_assumptions.new_FL_assumption: Material, Container, Location, Opening, Barrier, EventDefinition, ExecutedEvent and MaterialReference are distinct sorts; no event-result cast.
Most recent compatible patient means nearest preceding explicitly bound instance in the same episode, with ambiguity a stop. A Container predicate cannot take a Material patient.
Directional spatial-process modifiers can apply to spatially extended agitation/warming as well as Motion. This asserts a spatial extent, not traversal.
Through-path modifiers require Motion with a bound Material theme; a merely situated nonmotion process does not license passage.
Postposed modifiers use nearest preceding domain-compatible event/reference. Known nonmatching contributions remain consumed separately; unknown contributions are barriers, never skipped.
A declared Container has one canonical mouth Opening, key=(episode,container_instance,mouth). CHY and CHOR are paid part descriptors of this same kind. No equation follows from a repeated word alone.

Owner resolution requires exactly one bound Container in the current scope, or a bound explicit Motion source Container. A receiving Location is not automatically a new Container. Missing/ambiguous owner blocks part creation.
Canonical mouth can be introduced by paid CHY/CHOR part descriptor only when owner is bound. Narrow passage, fine barrier and wall are distinct parts/sites; they do not become that mouth.

o on a t/k-selected Partition executes Partition(x)->released r, retained k, then outward Motion of the selected addressed branch. This is one compound event definition, with real sequential subevents, not a cast.

Unmarked event words in this prospective FL interpretation assert completed events in written order. This is a new force assumption, not proven by FK prose. Explicit intent would require a paid marker and be classified separately.
Seal establishes impermeable CLOSED(O), open establishes OPEN(O). Completed traversal requires PASSABLE(O), defined here as OPEN(O). Same definitions and event arities in both models.

Aperture state persists only within the explicitly bound episode until an explicit paid state-changing event. Unknown interval contribution, owner change, episode ambiguity or state uncertainty blocks classification.
A required executable intended Motion has the same precondition at its execution time; a hypothetical/possible path or bare desire supplies no actual traversal consequence.

The seed is one declared paragraph episode for local construction only. A paragraph boundary elsewhere is not an automatic episode-identity proof; cross-paragraph comparisons are blocked without explicit paid continuation.

G6_motion_effect.Motion: o(E) adds OUTWARD(from bound owner-C); preserves Material patient and all declared outputs. Missing owner blocks.
G6_motion_effect.SelectedPartition: o(k(Partition))=Partition(x,r,k) then Motion(k,OUTWARD(C)); o(t(Partition)) analogous for r. Motion consumes the selected MATERIAL branch. Other branch remains a paid partition output; no claim that both are named products.
G6_motion_effect.UnselectedPartition: o has no domain on unselected Partition; stop rather than select a free branch.

C_part_location_scopes.chekchy: A FineBarrier(C)->Barrier F; B FinePassage(C)->Location F; path can cross this paid part, but F != O absent explicit identity evidence.
C_part_location_scopes.cheol: Introduce receiving Location V; does not erase C owner or identify a mouth.

opening_identity_algorithm: Resolve same episode without unknown barrier or unlicensed reset.
Resolve owner C uniquely by explicit Motion source if present, otherwise unique scoped bound Container.
CHY/CHOR descriptor constructs/resolves canonical key(episode,C,mouth). No identity from surface/paragraph alone.
Compare complete keys, not just opening types. Different owner/key means non-discriminating.
If owner is missing, ambiguous, or only supplied as a raw unknown, return UNBOUND_IDENTITY; no free opening.

event_force_contract.default: ASSERTED_COMPLETED under new A10 for recognized bound event words only.
event_force_contract.intended: Only explicit paid intent marker may create REQUIRED_EXECUTABLE; no such marker added to FK inventory. Conditional intended-event theorem can be stated, but enumeration must not label unknown markers as intent.
event_force_contract.possible_path: Location/path mention alone is not completed or intended traversal.
event_force_contract.unknown_interval: Unknown group may encode negation, permission, reversal, episode change or reopening; therefore it blocks state consequence, even if literal forms match.

fixed_consequence.traversal: Later actual/required executable bound Motion(theme M) through CHY(O) requires OPEN(O) at execution.
fixed_consequence.necessary_condition: For each independently fully bound common interval satisfying all frozen assumptions, CLOSED(O) persisting until traversal conflicts with A; B is locally compatible with this one precondition. This is a conditional universal consequence, not a full reading or B winner.
fixed_consequence.seed: FK CHY27 precedes QOKEEY57 CHOR58. No later CHY traversal in its60groups, and signature conflict14 prevents a verified full derivation. Seed supplies no state discriminator.

selection_contract.candidate_unit: Root may enumerate complete admitted exposed own-reader ZL/IT native paragraphs containing fixed literal QOKEEY and later CHY after this freeze; RF own-locus diagnostics only. No fresh reading performed by author.
selection_contract.minimal_order: bound completed QOKEEY, bound CHOR object, later CHY attached to actual/intended Motion of a nonnull bound Material theme; no physical-line sentence rule.
selection_contract.whole_capacity_gate: Every intervening contribution must have paid unchanged meaning and typed consumption. Also derive prior participants/owner needed by interval. A parsed span with unbound subject is not whole-capacity success.
selection_contract.identity_gate: Same canonical opening instance, owner and episode; same word or paragraph membership insufficient.
selection_contract.state_gate: No explicit reopening/closure change and no unknown/owner/episode gaps.
outcomes: CONFLICT_A_COMPATIBLE_B only for the complete frozen conjunction.
UNBOUND_COMPOSITION_OR_IDENTITY_OR_FORCE: missing capacity, not meaning failure.
COMMON_SIGNATURE_CONFLICT: reject shared model application, not select one lexical value.
selection_contract.stop_rule: No role/domain/alias/default or coercion adjustment after seeing candidate paragraphs. No automatic expansion if no adequate interval exists.
